name: What types of pipes can Alpha-Plumbing Services repair?

mainEntity.name: What types of pipes can Alpha-Plumbing Services repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Alpha-Plumbing Services, LLC is equipped to repair leaks in various types of pipes commonly found in residential and commercial properties. This includes copper pipes, PEX (cross-linked polyethylene) tubing, PVC (polyvinyl chloride) pipes, and galvanized steel pipes. Our experienced plumbers have the knowledge and specialized tools for effective repair across these different materials, ensuring a long-lasting solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: We repair leaks in common pipe types, including copper, PEX, PVC, and galvanized steel, using specialized tools and expertise.
